name: Orelle
description: Orelle sits in the Maurienne valley on the south side of the mountains — the 'fourth valley' access to Les 3 Vallées. The 3 Vallées Express gondola reaches Val Thorens in 13 minutes (new cable car in 2021). 85% of slopes above 1,800m. 3 peaks over 3,000m: Pointe du Bouchet (3,230m), Cime Caron (3,195m), Col de Rosaël (3,000m). Free parking at gondola base. HOB Orelle (new 2024) — hotel, dormitories, restaurant. 740 covered parking spaces (2025). Direct shuttle from Saint-Michel-de-Maurienne station. Originally a mining village — transformed into a ski resort in 1996 with the 3 Vallées Express gondola.

overview.atmosphere: Quiet gateway village from the Maurienne valley. Cheapest access to Les 3 Vallées (600 km). Direct gondola to Val Thorens at 3,200m. Free parking, no queues.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Snowshoeing, heritage walks, Chapelle Notre Dame des Anges, barrage de Bissorte

honest_drawbacks: Very quiet — limited restaurants and apres
